send_message_to_user: send a message with optional file attachment to a user by their user id
create_group_conversation: create a new group conversation with at least two other participants and an optional title
search_conversations: search conversations by participant ids, title, or message content with optional date range filters
read_conversation_messages: read messages from a conversation with pagination, offset, limit, and optional date range filters
list_recent_conversations: list recent conversations ordered by last update with paginated recent messages per conversation
